summary: Executed real backend + frontend validation for opening-balance deposit behavior using the public URL. Verified normal pre-opening deposit rejection, opening-balance deposit acceptance before opening date, reporting/journal behavior, data-flow validity, and installer availability.
critical_code_review_comments: Deposit create/update logic correctly bypasses pre-opening date restriction only when is_opening_balance_deposit=true and forces accounting_start_datetime to opening_balance_date.
Opening-balance deposit journal entry uses entry_date=opening_balance_date with lines (ودائع لأجل / رصيد افتتاحي) and excludes البنك as required.
server.py remains very large (>700 lines), which increases accounting-regression risk and should be modularized.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ITER65 bank and one opening-balance deposit; cleaned via test teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (admin/Admin@123, social-solidarity) and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Pytest run passed (2/2) covering requested deposit scenarios + /api/admin/data-flow-validation + /api/download/setup and local installer existence. UI run passed on /bank/industrial-development/register confirming opening-balance-deposit-toggle is visible and selectable.
rca of the issue: No regression detected in requested scope. Behavior aligns with expected fix: normal deposits before opening date are blocked, while opening-balance deposits are accepted with accounting_start_datetime pinned to opening_balance_date and reflected correctly in journal/report logic.
